rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Provides advise on how to mitigate or remediate a vulnerability when a VEX product is affected by it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: productMetadata
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to additional product metadata such as a reference within an organization's product catalog.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isci
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: International Standard Collection Identifier (ISCI) is a variable-length identifier standardized by [ISO 27730](https://www.iso.org/standard/44293.html) for identifying collections held by libraries, archives, museums, and other memory institutions. It consists of two parts: the identifier for the assigning organization (an ISIL) enclosed in square brackets, followed by a local collection identifier string (e.g., `[FR-751041001]Casadesus1`).
Safety risk level.
Provides a numerical (0-10) representation of the severity of a vulnerability.
RoleRelationship represents a relationship between an entity holding a role and the scope or context in which that role applies. The givenRole property specifies the role assigned.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDeclaredLicense
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Artifact was discovered to actually contain each `to` /SimpleLicensing/AnyLicenseInfo (for example, as detected by automated tooling).
Describes a sensor used for collecting the data.
References an Element on the right-hand side of a relationship.
Specifies the type of the external reference.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: numeric
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data consists only of numeric entries.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: build
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated as part of the process of building the software to create a releasable artifact (e.g., executable or package) from data such as source files, dependencies, built components, build process ephemeral data, and other SBOMs.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: query
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is publicly available, but not all at once, and can only be accessed through queries which return parts of the dataset.
The point in time when an element or an action starts, becomes applicable, or becomes valid.
This is how the currentState of an affected Element is found.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: validatedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been validated on the `to` Element(s).
A map of Element identifiers that are used within an SpdxDocument but defined external to that SpdxDocument.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used when the type does not match any of the other options.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: archive
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is an archived collection of one or more files (.tar, .zip, etc.).
A collection of Elements, not necessarily with unifying context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: draft
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Not yet finalized; under development or review.
Energy quantity.
Provides a CVSS version 4 assessment for a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtime
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated through instrumenting the system running the software, to capture only components present in the system, as well as external call-outs or dynamically loaded components. In some contexts, this may also be referred to as an "Instrumented" or "Dynamic" SBOM.
Artifact representing a serialization instance of SPDX data containing the definition of a particular Element.
Abstract ancestor class for all VEX relationships.
Class that describes a build instance of software/artifacts.
An entity that is authorized to issue identification credentials.
Information about the relationship between two Elements.
A collection of SPDX Elements that could potentially be serialized.
Provides the location of an external reference.
Type of support that is associated with an artifact.
Class that describes an instance of Hardware.
Inspection Process defines specific various processes needed to satisfy the inspection requirements for a specific product or service.
Identifies the text of one or more copyright notices for a software Package, File or Snippet, if any.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nli
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Natural Location Identifier (NLI)](https://eccma.org/enli-eccma-natural-location-identifier/) is a 14- or 15-character alphanumeric string standardized by [ISO 8000-118](https://www.iso.org/standard/85428.html) that uniquely identifies a three-dimensional geographic point location. The identifier is generated from geodetic coordinates and elevation data. For electronic storage, the `ISO.NLI:` prefix shall be retained (e.g., `ISO.NLI:41TS8M-A8ELTQ-H2`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nuget
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a NuGet package. The package locator format is defined in the [NuGet documentation](https://docs.nuget.org) and looks like `package/version`.
ManufactureAction represents the act of creating a product by a manufacturing process.
Test Process defines the testing process for an element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: obsoleted
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Superseded or not valid at present.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: crystalsKyber
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Kyber](https://pq-crystals.org/kyber/)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasConcludedLicense
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Artifact is concluded by the SPDX data creator to be governed by each `to` /SimpleLicensing/AnyLicenseInfo. If the `to` of an Artifact's `hasConcludedLicense` is not the same as the `to` of its `hasDeclaredLicense`, a written explanation should be provided in the comment field of the `hasConcludedLicense` relationship.
The assessment of the state of a requirement.
This process is used to determine the state of an affected Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: core
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Core profile specification.
A concrete subclass of Element used by Individuals in the Core profile.
Property that describes the digest of the build configuration file used to invoke a build.
Specifies the CVSS base, temporal, threat, or environmental severity type.
Provides information about the primary purpose of the software artifact.
Domain in which the AI package can be used.
A statement of how, or for what purpose, an item or artifact is intended to be used.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: complete
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relationship is known to be exhaustive.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isil
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Identifier for Libraries and Related Organizations (ISIL)](https://slks.dk/english/work-areas/libraries-and-literature/library-standards/isil/) is a unique alphanumeric code for identifying libraries, archives, museums, and related organizations standardized by [ISO 15511](https://www.iso.org/standard/77849.html). It consists of a prefix—which may be an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code or a non-country code assigned by the ISIL Registration Authority—followed by a unit identifier, totaling up to 16 characters (e.g., `FI-Sipoo-Sö` or `ZDB-1-SBD`). Valid symbols include any alphanumeric character, solidus (`/`), hyphen-minus (`-`), or colon.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: mailingList
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the mailing list used by the maintainer for a package.
Verification postcondition that are true immediately after a verification method has been performed
Impact justification label to be used when linking a vulnerability to an element representing a VEX product with a VexNotAffectedVulnAssessmentRelationship relationship.
An Individual Value for License when no assertion can be made about its actual value.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: mavenCentral
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Maven repository artifact. The artifact locator format is defined in the [Maven documentation](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-naming-conventions.html) and looks like `groupId:artifactId[:version]`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An authentication protocol not covered by one of the other AuthenticationProtocolTypes.
Identifies who or what supplied the artifact or VulnAssessmentRelationship referenced by the Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ark
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Archival Resource Key (ARK)](https://arks.org/about/), is a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) suited to being a persistent identifier for information objects of any type, standardized by the [ARK Identifier Scheme](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-kunze-ark/) Internet-Draft. It consists of the "ark:" label followed by a Name Assigning Authority Number, a forward slash, a name, and an optional qualifier (e.g., `ark:12148/btv1b8449691v/f29`).
A Package that contains a dataset.
The class that helps note down the quantity of energy consumption and the unit used for measurement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: generates
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element generates each `to` Element.
A probability score between 0 and 1 of a vulnerability being exploited.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: availableFrom
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is available from the additional supplier described by each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: file
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a single file which can be independently distributed (configuration file, statically linked binary, Kubernetes deployment, etc.).
Describes the type of annotation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: operatingSystem
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is an operating system.
A reference to a resource outside the scope of SPDX 3 content related to an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDocumentation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is documented by each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the software support channel or other support information for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: function
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Simulation the function of the hardware.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: trainedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been trained on the `to` Element(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: orcidid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Open Researcher and Contributor ID (ORCID) iD](https://info.orcid.org/what-is-orcid/) is a unique identifier for authors and contributors in scholarly communication; as a subset of the International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI), it typically appears as a URI such as `https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0097`.
Specifies the VEX justification type.
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a License which has additional text applied to it.
Property describing the session in which a build is invoked.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: scrapingScript
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset provider is not making available the underlying data and the dataset shall be reassembled, typically using the provided script for scraping the data.
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a set of licensing information where only one of the elements applies.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bower
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Bower package. The package locator format, looks like `package#version`, is defined in the "install" section of [Bower API documentation](https://bower.io/docs/api/#install).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: doesNotAffect
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Security/Vulnerability has no impact on each `to` Element. The use of the `doesNotAffect` is constrained to `/Security/VexNotAffectedVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.
This is the individual, business, or organization who was previously managing goods, services, or assets.
The ProcessReadinessType is defined by the enumeration.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Core/IntegrityMethod is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing this version, or any later version, of the indicated License.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hardware
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Hardware profile specification.
Refers to any unit of content that can be associated with a distribution of software.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noAssertion
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data type is not known.
Identifies an external Element used within an SpdxDocument but defined external to that SpdxDocument.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: modifiedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is modified by each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: functionalSafety
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the FunctionalSafety profile specification.
Quantity is the amount in the selected QUDT unit.
A buildId is a locally unique identifier used by a builder to identify a unique instance of a build produced by it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: secureSoftwareAttestation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to information assuring that the software is developed using security practices as defined by [NIST SP 800-218 Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) Version 1.1](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/218/final) or [CISA Secure Software Development Attestation Form](https://www.cisa.gov/resources-tools/resources/secure-software-development-attestation-form).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasRequirement
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a requirement on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fail
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates a failed evaluation where the requirement or condition is not met.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: image
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is a collection of images such as pictures of animals.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: blake2b512
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: BLAKE2b algorithm with a digest size of 512, as defined in [RFC 7693](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc7693/) Section 4.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDeletedFile
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a file deleted from the `from` Element (`from` hasDeletedFile `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: chat
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the instant messaging system used by the maintainer for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: clear
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Unlimited. Subject to standard copyright rules, the dataset may be shared freely, without restriction.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iban
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: International Bank Account Number (IBAN) is a system for identifying bank accounts across national borders standardized by [ISO 13616](https://www.iso.org/standard/81090.html). It consists of up to 34 alphanumeric characters, including a country code, two check digits, and a basic bank account number. While spaces may be inserted for human readability, they must be omitted when used for electronic data exchange (e.g., `IE64IRCE92050112345678`).
Refers to any object that stores content on a computer.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: packagedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a packaged instance of the `from` Element (`from` packagedBy `to`).
Specifies the algorithm used for calculating the hash value.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDependencyManifest
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has manifest files that contain dependency information in each `to` Element.

**DEPRECATED in SPDX 3.1.** Use [/Core/startTime](../../Core/Properties/startTime.md) instead.
Property describing the start time of a build.
Explains why a VEX product is not affected by a vulnerability. It is an alternative in VexNotAffectedVulnAssessmentRelationship to the machine-readable justification label.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inconclusive
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Inconclusive refers to a result or outcome from a verification, test, or analysis that cannot be clearly classified as either positive (successful, pass) or negative (failed, reject). An inconclusive result means there was not enough clear evidence, data, or signal to make a definitive determination, and further investigation or additional testing is necessary. An inconclusive result always shall need a comment on it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: directory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The file represents a directory and all content stored in that directory.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasEvidence
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is considered as evidence for the `from` Element (`from` hasEvidence `to`).
Provides an unambiguous mechanism for conveying a URI fragment portion of an Element ID.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ibrn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Business Registration Number (IBRN)](https://ekys.org/business_identifiers/) is a unique identifier for legal entities standardized by [ISO 8000-116](https://www.iso.org/standard/75117.html). It is composed of two parts: a jurisdiction prefix and a local authoritative legal entity identifier (ALEI), separated by a colon. The prefix contains an ISO 3166 country code, an optional subdivision code, and a register code (e.g., `US-DE.BER:3031657`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: privacyAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a privacy assessment for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: symlink
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: This file represents a symbolic link (soft link).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: container
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a container image which can be used by a container runtime application.
Identifies the name of an Element as designated by the creator.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/SimpleLicensing/AnyLicenseInfo is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A standard with which the artifact complies.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityVulnerability
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A contact for reporting security vulnerabilities.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: purchaseOrder
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a purchase order for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: eli
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [European Legislation Identifier (ELI)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/content/help/eurlex-content/eli.html) is a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) that uniquely identifies a legal resource, typically consisting of a document type, adoption year, and document number (e.g., `http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/2847/oj`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityAdversaryModel
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the security adversary model for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: exportControlAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an export control assessment for a package.
Specifies the type of an annotation.
Defines the beginning of a range.
Records the biases that the dataset is known to encompass.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: kilowattHour
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Kilowatt-hour.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasPrerequisite
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a prerequisite on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Identifies all the text and metadata associated with a license in the license XML format.
A mathematically calculated representation of a grouping of data.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: x509Cert
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an X.509 certificate as defined in [RFC 5280](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc5280/). The primary media type shall be `application/pkix-cert`. The legacy media types `application/x-x509-ca-cert` and `application/x-x509-user-cert` may be used for backward compatibility, but shall not be used in new implementations. NOTE — RFC 5280 supersedes earlier X.509 profiles, including RFC 1422. Existing references based on RFC 1422 remain valid.
Product Part Number as defined by OEM.

It is the authoritative or credible entity, document, or body of knowledge that provides the meaning of an additionalInformation key and/or its values, ensuring accuracy, context, and standardization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: releaseNotes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the release notes for a package.
A location where a package or an item will be dropped off or delivered.
Specifies whether a license or additional text identifier has been marked as deprecated.
A rationale is supporting information that provides the underlying justification or reasoning for an associated element, decision, or process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: performedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `from` Action is performedBy `to` Agent.
Version string for an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: highAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 4 - High automation. The system performs parts of its mission without external intervention.
The CreateProcess refers to the abstract process class that can be used to represent the process of creation of a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: none
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is 0.0.
responsibilityCategory classifies the nature or domain of a responsibility transfer.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: megajoule
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Megajoule.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Core/ElementCollection is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: development
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during development phase of an element.

referenceSpecification provides a reference to a DefinedType that defines the specific meaning, structure, and semantics of a Role. It connects the role to its authoritative source definition, ensuring consistent interpretation across different contexts.
This individual element was defined by the spec.
Abstract class for the portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a license.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noAssertion
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: No assertion can be made about the completeness of the relationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: software
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Software profile specification.
Weight to express relevance in de minimis consideration.
Provides an indication of where to retrieve an external Element.
Provides a set of values to be used to describe the common types of SBOMs that tools may create.
A prescribed change to a product.
The relative file name of a file to be excluded from the `PackageVerificationCode`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: design
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM of intended, planned software project or product with included components (some of which may not yet exist) for a new software artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: npm
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an npm package. The package locator format is defined in the [npm documentation](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v10/configuring-npm/package-json) and looks like `package@version`.
Confidentiality level.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sourceArtifact
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an artifact containing the sources for a package.
Products or commodities produced as a bulk unit are called bulk products. Commodities are often sold in bulk.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/ExpandedLicensing/LicenseAddition is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dependsOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element depends on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: riskAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a risk assessment for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasOptionalComponent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is an optional component of the `from` Element (`from` hasOptionalComponent `to`).
An Individual Value for Element representing a set of Elements with cardinality (number/count) of zero.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ibid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Business Identifier (IBID)](https://ekys.org/business_identifiers/) is a verifiable unique identifier for legal entities as defined in the [ISO/DIS 25500-3](https://www.iso.org/standard/87705.html) draft standard. It is composed of three data elements: the International Business Registration Number (IBRN), the legal name, and the date of origin formatted as eight numeric characters (YYYYMMDD). Each element is separated by a pipe character (`|`) (e.g., `US-DE.BER:3031657|Code Management Association|19990420`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fullAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 5 - Full automation. The system is capable of performing its entire mission without external intervention.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runsOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element (the instructions) runs on each `to` /Hardware/Hardware (processing element), during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ecli
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [European Case Law Identifier (ECLI)](https://data.europa.eu/data/datasets/european-case-law-identifier-ecli) is a uniform identifier for judicial decisions across Europe. It consists of five mandatory components: the "ECLI" prefix, a country code, a court code, the year of the decision, and a unique serial number (e.g., `ECLI:EU:C:2023:94`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact has been released, and is supported from the supplier. There is a validUntilDate that can provide additional information about the duration of support.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: directDownload
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is publicly available and can be downloaded directly.
A string in the license expression format.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inspection
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A thorough examination or checking of documentation, records, processes, or systems to confirm compliance or adherence. An inspection needs to have a defined set of acceptance criteria (e.g. a checklist), a documentation of roles involved in the inspection (e.g. to document the inspector's independence) and a clear documentation of when and how it was performed.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasVariant
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a variant the `from` Element (`from` hasVariant `to`).
Provides the location of an exploit catalog.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: model
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a machine learning or artificial intelligence model.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: simpleLicensing
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the SimpleLicensing profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: metrics
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to metrics related to a package such as OpenSSF scorecards.
Authentication protocol used by a server.
Additional relevance information.
The boundary definition is used to define boundaries.
Abstract ancestor class for all vulnerability assessments.
Provides a License author's preferred text to indicate that a file is covered by the License.
Capture the scope of information about a specific relationship between elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: serializedInArtifact
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` SpdxDocument can be found in a serialized form in each `to` Artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: configures
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is a configuration applied to each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assumes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element assumes each `to` /FunctionalSafety/Assumption.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityPolicy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to instructions for reporting newly discovered security vulnerabilities for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: reportedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability was first reported to a project, vendor, or tracking database for formal identification by each `to` Agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element doesn't fit into any of the other categories.
The measure of mass refers to the quantity of matter in an object or substance.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: verifiedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Requirement that has verification (test, review, analysis etc.) details defined in the `to` /FunctionalSafety/RequirementVerification.
A specification is a detailed description of the design, requirements, or features of a product, process, or system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: buildSystem
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the build system used to create or publish the package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: filesystemImage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a file system image that can be written to a disk (or virtual) partition.

rdf:Description.sh:message: Class is known to not derive from Extension and cannot be used

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Confidentiality level of the data points contained in the dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha256
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 256, as defined in [RFC 6234](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc6234/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: decommission
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications for a product's retirement and/or decommissioning.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: duns
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Data Universal Numbering System (D-U-N-S) Number](https://www.dnb.com/en-us/smb/duns.html) is a unique nine-digit identifier, issued by Dun & Bradstreet, that identifies a business entity, often on a location-specific basis.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: tracedToDetail
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Requirement is refined and further elaborated by each `to` Requirement, which contains more detailed implementation information.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: high
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The second-highest level of risk posed by an AI system.
An actual change to a product's location.

Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).
